Welcome_Subtitle: A local player and library manager for gameplay clips and recordings.
Welcome_Feature1_Desc: Watches your recording folders and organizes clips with quick date filtering and search.
Welcome_Feature2_Desc: Hardware-accelerated playback with timeline scrubbing, audio track mixing, and frame stepping.
Welcome_Feature3_Desc: Pin timestamps on the timeline to bookmark moments and jump between them in the drawer.
